title: Set up a site's shop floor
route: Manufacturing ➔ Master Data ➔ Organization ➔ Production Departments

tokens.v: A site has the departments, work centers, machines, rates and reference operations that its routings and production orders need.

achieves.text: A site has the departments, work centers, machines, rates and reference operations that its routings and production orders need.

tokens.v: Job Shop by Site is Active in
, and the site, its enterprise unit and a calendar with a shift exist.

before.text: Job Shop by Site is Active in Concept Activation (tcemm4600m000), and the site, its enterprise unit and a calendar with a shift exist.

tokens.v: Under Job Shop by Site, everything a routing points at belongs to one site. A production department groups the work centers that sit together and gives them an enterprise unit and a calendar. A costing work center sits above the planning work centers, so an operation can move to another work center after its costs are frozen. Machines are machine types placed in a work center as capacity groups, each with its machine numbers. Reference operations are the library of operations a routing is built from.
